scope: Pinned Supabase PostgreSQL single-attempt HBA publication, parser validation and durable reload-signal acknowledgment witness. Exact HBA-slot success settlement includes host SIGKILL after durable witness publication. Not activation confirmation, job settlement or supervisor integration.
checks: native local Linux daemon
host headroom checked before bounded probe
owned exact container is isolated and memory bounded
upstream bootstrap roles present
neighbor role is unprivileged without inherited memberships
actual HBA apply has zero parser errors and reload acknowledgment
completion witness durably binds exact journal and desired bytes
valid apply retains pending journal
valid execution cannot dispatch apply twice
valid publication retirement preserves unknown activation
valid applied witness settles only the HBA pending slot
invalid applied HBA cannot produce completion witness
invalid apply retains pending journal
invalid execution cannot dispatch apply twice
invalid publication retirement preserves unknown activation
missing successful witness keeps invalid attempt pending
actual host SIGKILL after successful completion persistence
fresh ownership settles exact durable completion after host death
success settlement makes no apply or PostgreSQL SQL call
success settlement leaves applied HBA bytes unchanged
successful historical outcome remains readable after journal removal
fixture baseline restored after applied-operation probes
disposable database did not OOM
exact disposable container absent from successful inventory
